scope: Classical effective-model 2D periodic zero-mean vorticity, finite Galerkin box; not native P000 fluid derivation, not 3D certification.

brc_audit.carrier: Integer input/output wavevectors and complex amplitudes; ordered pair branches.
brc_audit.observer: Every nonlinear output coefficient in the retained Galerkin box.
brc_audit.safe_aggregation: Sum (p,q) and (q,p) with full signed coefficients; keep p+q and conjugate modes. Rebuild a support plan whenever support changes.
brc_audit.applied: Observer/provenance audit and exact integer zero tests.
brc_audit.not_applicable: Positive Weighted-BRC recurrence theorems do not establish signed/complex cancellation or Navier-Stokes stability. No theorem/tool performance novelty is claimed.

public_sources.target: getConvection; compare existing Vortex form, not only Standard

finite_map.zero_tests: Integer cross product zero or squared lengths equal; retain complex amplitudes otherwise.
finite_map.proof: Expand -u.grad(w) in Fourier coefficients, then add the ordered (p,q) and (q,p) contributions. The p=q contribution vanishes. This is standard algebra, not a new physical model.
finite_map.fft: Four real inverse FFT fields (u,v,wx,wy), physical product -(u*wx+v*wy), one forward real FFT. Pad to M=next_fast_len(3K+1)>3K, extract the same retained box.

experiment.implementation: Independent NumPy/SciPy/Numba reference, not actual JAX-CFD, Dedalus or spectralDNS runtime.
experiment.environment: Python 3.13.5; NumPy 2.3.5; SciPy 1.17.0; Numba 0.65.1; FFT workers=1; no fastmath; JIT warmup excluded; median of 9 timing groups; shared container.
experiment.dynamic_cost: Includes exact nonzero extraction and pair computation every RHS call. No magnitude pruning.
experiment.fixed_plan_cost: One-time plan construction reported separately; cannot reuse after support changes.
experiment.checks: Conjugacy, instantaneous inviscid energy/enstrophy derivatives, one analytic Fourier coefficient, same-shell zero nonlinearity. Floating tests, not interval proof.

integration.finding: Exact sparsity rapidly fills; simple hybrid did not deliver end-to-end speedup. Many new nonzero coefficients are tiny.

exact_input_pruning_envelope.proof: Use |p cross q| <= (|px|+|py|)*max(|qx|,|qy|), submultiplicativity of rectangular magnitude, expand the bilinear map at a+r, and sum. Restricting output cannot increase this absolute-sum bound.
exact_input_pruning_envelope.arithmetic: Treat saved binary64 coefficient components as exact dyadic rationals; Fraction computes A,B and bound exactly. Display rounded upward.
exact_input_pruning_envelope.snapshot: Fifth RK4 state from integration above; keep conjugate pair if max pair magnitude >=1e-8.
exact_input_pruning_envelope.exclusions: No floating kernel-roundoff bound, time-discretization bound, unresolved-mode bound, physical-model validation, or independent mathematical review. Rational audit currently costs more than FFT.

next: Develop cheap rigorously outward-rounded/blockwise pruning envelopes, include support/plan/audit/fallback costs, then test complete held-out 2D flows against a mature public solver. Do not promote a sparse-input microbenchmark to industrial acceleration.
